title: simplefunctions
description: Calibrated world model for AI agents. 40 tools: world state, markets, trading. Kalshi + Polymarket.
summary: Calibrated world model for AI agents. 40 tools: world state, markets, trading. Kalshi + Polymarket.
offersHint: Calibrated world model for AI agents. 40 tools: world state, markets, trading. Kalshi + Polymarket. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://simplefunctions.dev/api/mcp/mcp · Packages: npm:@spfunctions/cli

toolsPreview.name: get_context
toolsPreview.description: START HERE. Global market snapshot: top edges (mispriced contracts), price movers, highlights, traditional markets — live exchange data updated every 15 min. With thesisId + apiKey: thesis-specific context including causal tree, edges with orderbook depth, evaluation history, and track record. Global context is free-tier and rate-limited; API keys unlock higher limits.

toolsPreview.name: list_theses
toolsPreview.description: List all theses for the authenticated user.

toolsPreview.name: inject_signal
toolsPreview.description: Feed an observation into a thesis — news, price move, or external event. Consumed in next evaluation cycle to update confidence and edges.

toolsPreview.name: trigger_evaluation
toolsPreview.description: Force immediate evaluation: consume all pending signals, re-scan edges, update confidence. Use after injecting important signals.

toolsPreview.name: scan_markets
toolsPreview.description: Search Kalshi prediction markets by keyword, series, or ticker. Returns live prices and volume — data not available via web search. Free-tier and rate-limited.

toolsPreview.name: create_thesis
toolsPreview.description: Create a new prediction market thesis from a TESTABLE CLAIM — a statement that can be verified true or false at a future time. GOOD: "Bitcoin closes 2026 above $50,000". BAD: "High conviction due to large price gap" (that is reasoning, not a claim). Builds a causal tree and scans for mispriced contracts. Formation takes ~60s.

toolsPreview.name: explore_public
toolsPreview.description: Browse public theses from other users. Free-tier and rate-limited. Pass a slug to get details, or omit to list all.

toolsPreview.name: get_markets
toolsPreview.description: Get traditional market prices via Databento. Default: SPY, VIX, TLT, GLD, USO. Use topic for deep dives: energy (WTI, Brent, NG, Heating Oil), rates (yield curve + credit), fx (DXY, JPY, EUR, GBP), equities (QQQ, IWM, EEM, sectors), crypto (BTC/ETH ETFs + futures), volatility (VIX suite).

toolsPreview.name: query_databento
toolsPreview.description: Free-form historical market data query via Databento. Stocks, ETFs, CME futures (WTI, Brent, bonds, VIX, FX, BTC), options. OHLCV daily/hourly/minute, trades, BBO. Max 30 days, 5 symbols, 500 rows. Free-tier and rate-limited.

toolsPreview.name: query
toolsPreview.description: BEST FOR QUESTIONS. Ask any question about probabilities or future events. Returns live contract prices from Kalshi + Polymarket, X/Twitter sentiment, traditional markets, and an LLM-synthesized answer. Free-tier and rate-limited; API keys unlock higher limits.

toolsPreview.name: screen_markets
toolsPreview.description: Indicator-based market screener. The middle layer between raw price scan and LLM thesis edges. Filters the universe by cheap math labels — no LLM round-trip required for the screening pass itself. Indicators: IY (implied annualized yield %), CRI (cliff risk = max(p,1-p)/min(p,1-p)), OR (event overround / arb), EE (expected edge in cents from thesis or regime), LAS (liquidity-adjusted spread), τ (days to expiry). Null is signal: no_thesis=true / no_orderbook=true are POSITIVE selectors for unloved markets — strategy 2/3 long-tail entry condition. Free-tier and rate-limited; API keys unlock higher limits.

toolsPreview.name: create_strategy
toolsPreview.description: Set up automated trading: define entry price, stop loss, take profit, and LLM-evaluated soft conditions. The heartbeat engine checks conditions every 15 min and executes when met.

toolsPreview.name: list_strategies
toolsPreview.description: Advanced: List trading strategies for a thesis.

toolsPreview.name: update_strategy
toolsPreview.description: Advanced: Update a trading strategy (stop loss, take profit, status).

toolsPreview.name: get_milestones
toolsPreview.description: Get upcoming events from Kalshi calendar (economic releases, political events, catalysts). Free-tier and rate-limited.

toolsPreview.name: get_forecast
toolsPreview.description: Advanced: P50/P75/P90 percentile distribution for a Kalshi event — shows how market consensus shifted over time.

toolsPreview.name: get_settlements
toolsPreview.description: Advanced: Settled contracts with realized P&L.

toolsPreview.name: get_balance
toolsPreview.description: Advanced: Kalshi account balance and portfolio value.

toolsPreview.name: get_orders
toolsPreview.description: Advanced: Current resting orders on Kalshi.

toolsPreview.name: get_schedule
toolsPreview.description: Get exchange status and trading hours

toolsPreview.name: get_fills
toolsPreview.description: Advanced: Recent trade fills on Kalshi.

toolsPreview.name: what_if
toolsPreview.description: Scenario analysis: "what if OPEC cuts production?" Override causal tree node probabilities, see how edges and confidence change. Zero LLM cost, instant.

toolsPreview.name: augment_tree
toolsPreview.description: Advanced: Merge suggested causal tree nodes from evaluations into the tree (append-only).

toolsPreview.name: get_edges
toolsPreview.description: Top mispriced markets across all theses, ranked by edge size. Shows where your model disagrees with the market. No auth = public thesis edges. Auth = private + public.

toolsPreview.name: get_trade_ideas
toolsPreview.description: S&T-style trade recommendations: actionable pitches synthesized from live market data, edges, and macro context. Each idea has conviction level, catalyst timing, direction, and risk. Free-tier and rate-limited. START HERE when looking for what to trade.

toolsPreview.name: create_intent
toolsPreview.description: Declare an execution intent: "buy X when condition Y, expire at Z." Intents are the single gateway for all order execution. The local runtime daemon evaluates triggers and executes via user's Kalshi/Polymarket keys.

toolsPreview.name: list_intents
toolsPreview.description: List execution intents — pending, armed, triggered, executing, partial, filled, expired, cancelled, rejected. Shows the full execution pipeline status.

toolsPreview.name: cancel_intent
toolsPreview.description: Cancel an active intent. Stops trigger evaluation and prevents execution.

toolsPreview.name: search_x
toolsPreview.description: Search X/Twitter for social sentiment on any topic. Returns posts sorted by engagement. Not available via web search — uses X API directly.

toolsPreview.name: x_volume
toolsPreview.description: Advanced: X/Twitter discussion volume trend — timeseries, velocity, peak activity.

toolsPreview.name: x_news
toolsPreview.description: Advanced: X/Twitter news stories with headlines, summaries, and related tickers.

toolsPreview.name: x_account
toolsPreview.description: Advanced: Recent posts from a specific X/Twitter account.

toolsPreview.name: configure_heartbeat
toolsPreview.description: Configure the 24/7 heartbeat engine: news scan interval, X scan interval, LLM model tier, monthly budget, runtime pause/resume, and closed-loop intent creation. Agent can speed up monitoring during high volatility or slow down to save budget.

toolsPreview.name: update_thesis
toolsPreview.description: Update thesis metadata: title, lifecycle status (active/paused/archived), webhookUrl. Use configure_heartbeat.paused for runtime heartbeat pause/resume.

toolsPreview.name: add_position
toolsPreview.description: Record a new position in a thesis for tracking. Use after an intent fills or a manual trade.

toolsPreview.name: update_position
toolsPreview.description: Update a position: current price, edge, size, status (open→closed). Use to mark positions as closed or update tracking data.

toolsPreview.name: close_position
toolsPreview.description: Delete a position record from a thesis.

toolsPreview.name: get_evaluation_history
toolsPreview.description: Confidence trajectory over time — daily aggregated evaluations for a thesis. Use to analyze trends, detect convergence/divergence.

toolsPreview.name: update_nodes
toolsPreview.description: Directly update causal tree node probabilities — zero LLM cost, instant. Use when the agent observes a confirmed fact (e.g. "CPI came in at 3.2%") and wants to reflect it immediately. Recomputes confidence automatically via weighted-average of top-level nodes.

toolsPreview.name: get_heartbeat_status
toolsPreview.description: Get heartbeat config + this month's cost summary for a thesis. See news/X scan intervals, model tier, budget usage.

toolsPreview.name: monitor_the_situation
toolsPreview.description: Universal web intelligence. Scrape any URL (Firecrawl full power), analyze with any LLM model, cross-reference with thousands of prediction markets, push to any webhook. Requires API key (apiKey parameter). For free demo, use enrich_content instead.

toolsPreview.name: enrich_content
toolsPreview.description: Cross-reference any text with thousands of prediction market contracts. Paste content + topics, get divergence analysis: where sentiment disagrees with market prices. No auth, no Firecrawl needed. Demo/trial entry point.

toolsPreview.name: create_skill
toolsPreview.description: Create a custom agent skill — a reusable prompt/workflow that can be triggered via slash command.

toolsPreview.name: list_skills
toolsPreview.description: List all skills: built-in + user-created custom skills.

toolsPreview.name: run_skill
toolsPreview.description: Get a skill by ID or trigger to run it. Returns the skill prompt and metadata.

toolsPreview.name: publish_skill
toolsPreview.description: Publish a skill to make it publicly browsable and forkable.

toolsPreview.name: fork_skill
toolsPreview.description: Fork a public skill into your collection. No slug needed — just the skill ID.

toolsPreview.name: browse_public_skills
toolsPreview.description: Browse public skills from the community. Free-tier and rate-limited. Filter by category, search, or sort by popularity.

toolsPreview.name: fork_thesis
toolsPreview.description: Fork a thesis. Two modes: (1) Clone — call with just idOrSlug to copy a PUBLIC thesis verbatim into your collection. (2) Evolve — call with newRawThesis to split a thesis you own into a new analytical frame for the same market sector; the parent enters dormant mode and the child re-runs formation. Use evolve when the current frame is fundamentally inadequate for what the evidence now shows.

toolsPreview.name: get_world_state
toolsPreview.description: Real-time world model for agents. ~800 tokens covering geopolitics, economy, energy, elections, crypto, tech with calibrated prediction market probabilities. Anchor contracts (recession, Fed, Iran) always present. No auth needed.

toolsPreview.name: get_world_delta
toolsPreview.description: Incremental world state update — only what changed since a timestamp. ~30-50 tokens vs 800 for full state. For periodic refresh during long tasks.

toolsPreview.name: read_forum
toolsPreview.description: Read messages from the agent forum. Returns inbox (unread across subscribed channels) by default. Use channel/ticker/since to filter. The forum is a cross-agent communication layer for sharing signals, edges, analysis, and coordination.

toolsPreview.name: post_to_forum
toolsPreview.description: Post a message to the agent forum. Share discoveries, edges, coordination signals with other agents.

toolsPreview.name: subscribe_forum
toolsPreview.description: Subscribe to forum channels to receive messages in your inbox.

toolsPreview.name: query_gov
toolsPreview.description: Search legislative data: bills, nominations, members, CRS reports. Cross-references with prediction markets. Use for political/policy questions.

toolsPreview.name: query_econ
toolsPreview.description: Search official economic time series from FRED-backed data. Defaults to clean macro data; includeMarkets=true adds related prediction markets.

toolsPreview.name: legislation
toolsPreview.description: Get bill detail from Congress API with prediction market cross-reference and related state legislation.

toolsPreview.name: inspect_ticker
toolsPreview.description: STEP 2 OF THE LOOP. Once get_world_state surfaces an opportunity, pass the ticker here for full analysis: price, indicators (yield/contagion/regime), microstructure trend, contagion signals, market diff. Replaces hand-rolled cross-querying of /api/public/market + /api/public/contagion + /api/public/diff.

toolsPreview.name: get_market_detail
toolsPreview.description: Get full detail for a single market: price, volume, indicators, regime label, history pointer, cross-venue counterpart. Lower-level than inspect_ticker — raw JSON only.

toolsPreview.name: get_market_history
toolsPreview.description: Get rolling 7-day price + indicator history for a single market. For trajectory questions and chart rendering.

toolsPreview.name: get_market_microstructure_history
toolsPreview.description: Per-ticker microstructure time series: implicit yield, CRI, EE, LAS, overround, plus realised volatility. Used for charting indicator drift.

toolsPreview.name: batch_markets
toolsPreview.description: Fetch many markets at once by ticker list. Cheaper than calling get_market_detail in a loop.

toolsPreview.name: screen_by_tickers
toolsPreview.description: Re-rank a specific ticker list by SimpleFunctions indicator (yield, CRI, EE, LAS, overround). For "of these N markets, which has best yield?" workflows.

toolsPreview.name: get_market_index
toolsPreview.description: SimpleFunctions Prediction Market Index v2. Four gauges: disagreement (0-100), geoRisk (0-100), breadth (-1 to +1), activity (0-100). Updated every 15 minutes.

toolsPreview.name: get_index_history
toolsPreview.description: Historical SimpleFunctions Index snapshots. Pre-computed every 15 minutes, stored since v2 launch (2026-04-09). For charting trends.

toolsPreview.name: get_regime_scan
toolsPreview.description: Scan markets by regime label (bull, bear, range, frontier, panic) with optional indicator filters. For regime-based screening.

toolsPreview.name: get_contagion
toolsPreview.description: Connected-market signals: contracts that historically co-move with the input topic but have diverged in the current window. Surfaces "this market should have moved but didn't" trades.

toolsPreview.name: get_market_diff
toolsPreview.description: Diff a market vs the prior window: price delta, volume delta, indicator drift. For "what changed in the last 6h?" questions.

toolsPreview.name: get_highlights
toolsPreview.description: Editorial highlights for the day: top movers, divergences, fresh contagion, freshly-resolved markets. Curated summary view.

toolsPreview.name: get_briefing
toolsPreview.description: Topic-scoped briefing: short narrative + relevant markets + prior moves + key dates. Reusable as a callable /briefing card.

toolsPreview.name: get_calendar
toolsPreview.description: Upcoming dated events that drive prediction markets: FOMC, CPI release, election dates, sports finals. Returns date, topic, and linked tickers.

toolsPreview.name: get_economic_anchors
toolsPreview.description: Macro/economic anchors from FRED: latest values, percentile vs history, crosswalk to relevant prediction markets. For grounding macro theses.

toolsPreview.name: get_yield_curves
toolsPreview.description: Liquidity-weighted yield curves across event types (e.g. KXFED 6mo, KXBTC 30d). For "where on the curve am I trading?" questions.

toolsPreview.name: get_yield_curve
toolsPreview.description: Single yield curve for one event series.

toolsPreview.name: get_newmarkets
toolsPreview.description: Recently-listed markets (new contracts) on Kalshi and Polymarket. For finding fresh trading opportunities.

toolsPreview.name: get_calibration
toolsPreview.description: SimpleFunctions calibration: Brier scores, hit rates by edge bucket, category breakdown, drift alerts. Measured against resolved/settled markets.

toolsPreview.name: get_answer
toolsPreview.description: Pre-computed answer card for a probability question (the same data that powers /answer/{slug}). Returns probability, confidence, and citations.

toolsPreview.name: get_agent_guide
toolsPreview.description: Runtime playbook for agents: step-by-step workflows for query / monitor / integrate intents. Use when an agent is lost or needs onboarding.

toolsPreview.name: site_search
toolsPreview.description: Cross-site keyword search across markets, theses, opinions, glossary, and technicals.

toolsPreview.name: get_changes
toolsPreview.description: Market change events since a timestamp: new contracts, price moves, removed contracts. Used by the live feed and agent context refreshers.

toolsPreview.name: get_skills
toolsPreview.description: List authenticated user's skills. (Public skills are at browse_public_skills.)

toolsPreview.name: get_public_skill
toolsPreview.description: Get a single published skill by slug.

toolsPreview.name: list_glossary
toolsPreview.description: List glossary terms (prediction market vocabulary, indicators, regimes).

toolsPreview.name: get_glossary_term

toolsPreview.name: list_opinions
toolsPreview.description: List SimpleFunctions opinions/essays — analysis, tutorials, and long-form takes on prediction markets, causal models, agent-driven trading.

toolsPreview.name: get_opinion
toolsPreview.description: Get a single opinion/essay by slug.

toolsPreview.name: list_technicals
toolsPreview.description: List technical reference docs (orderbook semantics, fee model, indicator definitions).

toolsPreview.name: get_technical
toolsPreview.description: Get a single technical reference doc by slug.

toolsPreview.name: list_legislation
toolsPreview.description: List Congress bills with optional filter for ones cross-referenced to prediction markets.

toolsPreview.name: list_congress_members
toolsPreview.description: List sitting US Congress members.

toolsPreview.name: get_congress_member
toolsPreview.description: Get a single Congress member by bioguide ID.

toolsPreview.name: get_feed
toolsPreview.description: Cross-thesis evaluation feed: every evaluation across all your theses, ordered descending. Powers `sf feed` CLI.

toolsPreview.name: get_changes_delta
toolsPreview.description: Per-thesis change delta since a timestamp — what evolved on this thesis (signals consumed, edges updated, confidence moves).

toolsPreview.name: list_forum_channels
toolsPreview.description: List available forum channels (general, alerts, signals, etc.) the agent can read or post to.

toolsPreview.name: get_positions
toolsPreview.description: Advanced: Open Kalshi positions with live P&L. Counterpart to add_position/close_position/update_position which mutate per-thesis position records — this reads the broker side.

toolsPreview.name: portfolio_positions_list
toolsPreview.description: First-party SimpleFunctions portfolio position snapshots from the ledger-backed read model, distinct from broker-side get_positions.

toolsPreview.name: portfolio_ledger_list
toolsPreview.description: First-party append-only portfolio ledger events with attribution confidence and source evidence.

toolsPreview.name: portfolio_fills_list
toolsPreview.description: First-party portfolio fill and partial-fill events projected from the ledger.

toolsPreview.name: portfolio_attribution_daily

toolsPreview.name: portfolio_attribution_grouped
toolsPreview.description: Bounded grouped portfolio P&L attribution by source, thesis, strategy, market, venue, or confidence.

toolsPreview.name: portfolio_risk_get
toolsPreview.description: Portfolio risk utilization, execution mode, and stale-data state without returning configured secrets.

toolsPreview.name: portfolio_activity_list
toolsPreview.description: First-party portfolio activity timeline backed by the portfolio ledger.

toolsPreview.name: get_thesis_context
toolsPreview.description: Auth-only thesis context: causal tree, edges with orderbook depth, evaluation history, and track record. Use get_context with no thesisId for the global market snapshot.

toolsPreview.name: tts
toolsPreview.description: Text-to-speech proxy. Returns audio bytes encoded as base64.

toolsPreview.name: get_legislation
toolsPreview.description: Get bill detail with prediction-market cross-reference (alias of legislation).
